description: Every HaloPSA, HaloITSM and HaloCRM feature, plus a local SQLite store and cross-entity views the API can't return.

auth_env_var_specs.name: HALOPSA_CLIENT_ID
auth_env_var_specs.description: OAuth2 client ID from your Halo API application

auth_env_var_specs.name: HALOPSA_CLIENT_SECRET
auth_env_var_specs.description: OAuth2 client secret from your Halo API application

auth_env_var_specs.name: HALOPSA_TENANT
auth_env_var_specs.description: Your Halo tenant subdomain (e.g. "acme-msp" for acme-msp.halopsa.com)

auth_env_var_specs.name: HALOPSA_DOMAIN
auth_env_var_specs.description: Halo domain root: halopsa.com (default), haloitsm.com, or halocrm.com

auth_env_var_specs.name: HALOPSA_SCOPE
auth_env_var_specs.description: OAuth2 scope (defaults to "all"); set to a narrower scope when your API application requires it

auth_env_var_specs.name: HALOPSA_TOKEN
auth_env_var_specs.description: Pre-issued Bearer access token. Overrides the client_credentials flow when set.

novel_features.name: Triage queue
novel_features.description: See per-agent open ticket load, stale tickets, and 24-hour SLA-breach count in one table — the dispatcher view Halo's UI scatters across five tabs.

novel_features.name: Bulk age-out closer
novel_features.description: Find tickets stale in a status for N days, preview them, then bulk-close with a templated action via --apply.

novel_features.name: SLA breach radar
novel_features.description: List tickets whose targetdate falls in the next N hours, sorted by time-to-breach, with agent + client + current status.

novel_features.name: Agent workload
novel_features.description: Per-agent: open tickets, tickets touched this week, billable hours logged, oldest open ticket age.

novel_features.name: Client desk card
novel_features.description: One panel: client + sites + active tickets + open contracts + contract hours remaining + recent KB articles linked to their tickets + asset count.

novel_features.name: Asset ticket history
novel_features.description: Every ticket that touched this asset, chronological, with agent and time logged.

novel_features.name: KB suggest for ticket
novel_features.description: FTS5-rank KB articles against a ticket's summary + details + last action text; print top 5 with snippets.

novel_features.name: Time gap finder
novel_features.description: List tickets the agent touched this week that have zero time logged on them.

novel_features.name: Contract burn-down
novel_features.description: Per contract: hours bank, hours consumed this period (sum of billable time on that client's tickets), days remaining, projected overage.

novel_features.name: Ticket rules dump
novel_features.description: Print every ticket rule and workflow as readable flat text — conditions → actions, one block per rule.

novel_features.name: Changed-since
novel_features.description: Tickets where any action or status change occurred since timestamp, grouped by ticket.

novel_features.name: Standup digest
novel_features.description: Per-agent for the window: tickets closed, tickets reopened, time logged, top client.

novel_features.name: Multi-client overlay
novel_features.description: Rank all clients by a chosen metric (open tickets, stale, SLA at-risk, hours over bank). Top N out.
